verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a compliance and security platform with built-in AI agents (Fieldwork), so letting users plug in MCP servers as tools is a plausible capability to ask about. However, the evidence only documents Oneleet's own MCP server, which external assistants connect to. That is the server role and does not count toward client-side MCP consumption. Nothing shows Oneleet or Fieldwork can connect to user-supplied MCP servers; Fieldwork is described as using APIs and browser workflows, not MCP.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
